metadata.title: Detroit: Become Human transcript-derived benchmark
cautions: Source transcript is not executable game logic.
Some scene conditions and final chapter gates need manual verification.
Optional observations are not always modeled as player actions.
Chapter exits assume narrative order unless explicitly overridden.
enrichment_sources: Chapter Briefings and Public News are paraphrased from the Detroit: Become Human Wiki chapter pages (CC BY-SA 3.0) and the player-facing context text of data/context/chNN_*_en.json.

chapter_briefings.1: A high-rise apartment in Detroit, August 2038, at dusk. A household android, Daniel, has shot the father and holds the family's young daughter, Emma, at the edge of the rooftop terrace. Police and SWAT fill the apartment; the commander, Captain Allen, is tense and short on patience, a mother pleads in tears, a police helicopter circles. A wounded officer lies on the terrace. Daniel is agitated and screaming. Stakes: the child's life, the officers' lives and whether the deviant is stopped.
chapter_briefings.2: An android store in Detroit, rainy evening. A newly repaired AX400 housekeeper android, Kara, has just been reactivated with her memory wiped. Her owner, Todd Williams, a tired and irritable man, collects her and drives her home in silence. At a run-down suburban house his young daughter Alice waits at the foot of the stairs, quiet and withdrawn. Stakes: starting a new life in a tense, neglected household.
chapter_briefings.3: A busy square in Detroit's Greek District on an autumn morning. Markus, a caretaker android, is sent to pick up paint for his elderly owner, the painter Carl Manfred. A busker plays, a street preacher rails against androids to a small crowd, a vendor glares at passing androids, and a CyberLife store displays new models in its window. Stakes: completing the errand while staying out of trouble.
chapter_briefings.4: The Williams house in a run-down Detroit suburb, day. The house is filthy: dirty dishes, overflowing trash, laundry left outside for days. Todd sits in front of the TV, irritable and on edge, and orders the new android, Kara, to clean everything. His daughter Alice keeps to her room upstairs, silent and guarded, clearly afraid of her father. Stakes: keeping the household calm and reaching the lonely girl.
chapter_briefings.5: Carl Manfred's mansion in Detroit, morning. Carl, a famous elderly painter who uses a wheelchair, is cared for by his android, Markus. The grand house is full of art, a piano, a chess set and books. Carl is warm, sharp and blunt, treats Markus as more than a machine and invites him to paint for the first time. His son Leo, a resentful drug user, sometimes turns up asking for money. Stakes: Carl's well-being and Markus's sense of himself.
chapter_briefings.6: Night in Detroit. Connor, the android investigator from CyberLife, must find his new partner, homicide Lieutenant Hank Anderson, a gruff, hard-drinking cop who dislikes androids. Hank is drinking in a dingy bar where androids are not welcome. The case: Carlos Ortiz has been found stabbed to death in his house weeks ago, and his android is missing. Officers on scene are bored and dismissive. Stakes: earning Hank's cooperation and finding the deviant.
chapter_briefings.7: The Williams house on a stormy night. Todd, high on the drug Red Ice, is volatile and violent; at the dinner table he turns on his daughter Alice, who is terrified. The android Kara has been ordered not to move or interfere. Rain hammers the windows; the house feels like a trap. Stakes: Alice's safety, Kara's own survival, and whether Kara acts against her orders.
chapter_briefings.8: Carl Manfred's mansion, night, after a gallery evening. Carl is exhausted but in good spirits. The lights are on and the door is unlocked: Carl's son Leo, high and desperate for money, has broken in with friends. Leo is aggressive and resentful toward Markus, Carl is furious and frail. Police have been called. Stakes: Carl's health, Leo's safety and what Markus is willing to do under pressure.
chapter_briefings.9: The Detroit police station, night. The android found hiding in Carlos Ortiz's attic sits in the interrogation room, silent, damaged and frightened. Hank and other officers have failed to get it to speak; Detective Gavin Reed is impatient and hostile. Connor watches through the one-way mirror, then goes in to question it. Stakes: getting a confession and information about the deviants without the suspect breaking down or self-destructing.
chapter_briefings.10: Detroit, a cold, rainy night. Kara and Alice have fled the Williams house with nothing: no money, no papers, and Alice's clothes are still wet. The bus drops them in a poor, near-empty district with a laundromat, a convenience store, a motel and an abandoned house. Alice is exhausted, shivering and scared. Stakes: finding shelter, clothes and safety for the night without drawing attention.
chapter_briefings.11: An android junkyard outside Detroit, at night in the rain. Markus wakes up badly damaged, missing parts, half-blind and barely able to move. Broken androids lie in heaps; some are still functioning and pleading. No humans are in sight. A slope of debris leads toward a fence. Stakes: repairing himself with parts from other androids and escaping the dump alive.
chapter_briefings.12: Morning in Detroit. Connor reports to Amanda, his CyberLife handler, in the serene Zen Garden; she is calm, exacting and focused on results. At the police station, Hank has not arrived. Officers go about their work; Detective Gavin Reed is openly hostile toward Connor. Hank's desk and the station terminals hold case files. Stakes: making progress on the deviancy investigation and keeping Hank on side, under Amanda's expectations.
chapter_briefings.13: Early morning in a run-down district of Detroit. Kara and Alice, tired and scared, are waking from a night in hiding while police sweep the neighbourhood after a report about them. Connor and Hank are investigating nearby, Hank indifferent and Connor determined. The girl is fragile and relies on Kara completely. Stakes: whether the fugitives escape the police and whether Connor captures a deviant.
chapter_briefings.14: Ferndale, a deserted district of Detroit, at night. Markus follows strange symbols painted on walls through an abandoned train station, searching for the hidden android refuge called Jericho. The trail leads past rooftops and empty buildings to an old freighter in the harbour. The androids hiding inside are wary, scared and damaged. Stakes: finding Jericho and being accepted by its people.
chapter_briefings.15: Day, Detroit. Connor and Hank investigate a reported deviant, Rupert, at a cramped apartment covered in the symbol 'rA9' and full of pigeons. The deviant is nervous and unpredictable; Hank is skeptical, tired and sharp-tongued. Stakes: catching the deviant, the partnership with Hank, and Hank's safety during the chase.
chapter_briefings.16: Jericho, inside the rusting freighter, night. Dozens of hiding androids are damaged, cold and running out of thirium and parts. Three leaders, North, Josh and Simon, are wary of the newcomer Markus; North is angry, Josh cautious, Simon gentle. An old android named Lucy speaks in riddles. Stakes: whether Markus can earn the group's trust and whether he steps up to lead them.
chapter_briefings.17: A crumbling mansion outside Detroit, night. Zlatko, a big, overly friendly man, offers Kara help removing her tracker and getting papers, and leads her to the basement while Luther, a large, silent android, watches. Strange sounds come from upstairs; Alice is frightened and the house feels wrong. Stakes: Alice's safety and Kara's freedom and integrity.
chapter_briefings.18: Late at night in Detroit. Connor arrives at Hank Anderson's house. Hank is drunk, sunk in grief and depression, with a revolver on the floor and his big dog Sumo nearby. He is hostile and slurring. A new case is waiting: a homicide at the Eden Club. Stakes: Hank's condition and getting him to the crime scene.
chapter_briefings.19: A CyberLife warehouse near Detroit, night. Markus leads North, Simon and Josh on a raid for spare biocomponents and thirium for the dying androids of Jericho. Guards and patrol drones watch the site; a truck could carry supplies. The team is tense; North is eager, Josh nervous. Stakes: bringing back enough supplies without being caught or causing deaths.
chapter_briefings.20: The Eden Club, a sex club where androids are rented out, night. A man has been found strangled in a private room; a damaged Traci android lies nearby. Hank is uncomfortable and the officer on scene, Ben Collins, is matter-of-fact. A deviant Traci is somewhere among the dormant androids in the warehouse. Stakes: solving the murder and how Connor treats a frightened, cornered deviant.
chapter_briefings.21: A snowy highway at night outside Detroit. Kara, Alice and Luther drive an old car that breaks down near an abandoned amusement park, the Pirates' Cove. Alice is sick and feverish; Luther is quiet and protective. The park is dark and abandoned, but something stirs inside. Stakes: Alice's health and finding shelter and help for the night.
chapter_briefings.22: The Ambassador Bridge overlook, a snowy night. Hank sits alone near the river, drunk and morose, holding a bottle. He is hostile and probing, asking Connor what he really is. The distant lights of Canada are visible across the water. Stakes: Hank's state of mind and the relationship between the two partners.
chapter_briefings.23: The Stratford Tower, a TV broadcast building in downtown Detroit, day. Markus, North, Simon and Josh infiltrate it in disguise to hijack the live broadcast and send the androids' message to the world. Humans work in the offices; armed guards stand at checkpoints. Josh wants no violence, North is ready for it. Stakes: delivering the message, the lives of the staff, and getting the team out alive.
chapter_briefings.24: Hours after the Stratford Tower broadcast. Connor reports to Amanda in the Zen Garden, now snowy and cold. Then the Stratford Tower: the FBI has taken over, and Special Agent Perkins is condescending. Hank is irritated and protective of Connor. Clues may point to a deviant still hiding in the building. Stakes: catching the deviant and Connor's standing with CyberLife.
chapter_briefings.25: A farmhouse outside Detroit, day, under a gray sky. Rose, a calm, motherly woman, hides fugitive androids and helps them reach Canada; her son Adam is wary of the newcomers. Kara, Alice and Luther are tired from running. Police are searching houses in the area. Stakes: staying hidden, Alice's trust, and the chance to cross the border.
chapter_briefings.26: Capitol Park, a commercial district in Detroit, around two in the morning. Markus leads a group of androids to a CyberLife store full of androids for sale, aiming to free them and make a public statement. Drones and police cars patrol the area. North pushes for a forceful message. Stakes: the androids' public image, freeing the store androids, and the lives of anyone who interferes.
chapter_briefings.27: A modern house outside Detroit, snowy day. Connor and Hank visit Elijah Kamski, the reclusive founder of CyberLife, hoping he knows something about deviancy. Kamski is calm, curious and enigmatic; identical Chloe androids attend him. Hank is impatient. Stakes: getting answers about deviancy and what Connor is willing to do to get them.
chapter_briefings.28: Detroit, a cold winter day. Markus leads the androids of Jericho in a march through downtown, converting other androids along the way. North wants a show of strength, Josh insists on nonviolence, Simon is torn. Riot police line up ahead with orders to stop the march. Stakes: the androids' lives, public opinion, and whether the movement stays peaceful.
chapter_briefings.29: Detroit police station, night. CyberLife has told Connor he will be removed from the case after a failure. Connor reports to a cold Amanda in the Zen Garden, then sneaks into the station to search the evidence archive, where deactivated deviants are stored, for the location of Jericho. Hank has been suspended. Stakes: finding Jericho before Connor is taken off the case.
chapter_briefings.30.1: Night. Rose drives Kara and Alice, with Luther if he is still with them, to the freighter Jericho, where hiding androids may help them reach Canada. Radio news reports raids on androids across the city. Inside the ship, androids are frightened but hopeful; Alice is anxious. Stakes: Alice's safety and the chance to leave Detroit.
chapter_briefings.30.2: Jericho, the androids' refuge in a rusting freighter in the harbour, at night. Connor has tracked the deviants here and moves through the ship among frightened androids who do not yet suspect him. Somewhere aboard is their leader. Amanda expects Connor to accomplish his mission. Stakes: capturing the deviant leader and what Connor decides he is.
chapter_briefings.30.3: The captain's cabin aboard the Jericho freighter, night. Markus meets the other leaders of Jericho who are still with him; they are anxious, short of supplies, and divided about what to do next after the recent events. Outside the city is on edge, with raids reported everywhere. Stakes: the safety of everyone aboard and Markus's leadership.
chapter_briefings.31.1: Night, after the assault on Jericho. Survivors have regrouped in an abandoned church; many androids are missing or dead. Markus, shaken, goes to Carl's home to reflect before facing the survivors. His remaining companions look to him for direction. Stakes: the survival and future strategy of the android people.
chapter_briefings.31.2: Night, after the assault on Jericho. Connor stands in the Zen Garden before Amanda, who expects a report. Later he goes to Hank's house; Hank is drinking, gun on the table, and both are uneasy. Stakes: Hank's well-being and the next step in Connor's mission.
chapter_briefings.32.1: Detroit under curfew, night, snowing. Kara and Alice, with Luther if he is still with them, try to reach the bus terminal and the Canadian border. Army checkpoints stop civilians; soldiers are on edge and androids are being rounded up. Alice is frightened and quiet. Stakes: crossing the city undetected and getting Alice to safety.
chapter_briefings.32.2: Detroit, night, in the back of an army truck. Kara and Alice have been captured with other androids and are taken to a recycling camp where soldiers process and destroy androids. Soldiers are brutal and nervous; captives are terrified. Stakes: survival for Kara and Alice.
chapter_briefings.32.3: A rooftop overlooking downtown Detroit, night. Connor is on a mission to neutralize the deviant leader. Below, crowds of androids gather and soldiers and helicopters move in. Stakes: Connor's mission and the lives of the demonstrators.
chapter_briefings.32.4: CyberLife Tower, downtown Detroit, night. Connor arrives with an escort of CyberLife security guards who believe he is still loyal. Deep in the tower's basement, thousands of new androids wait in storage. Guards are watchful. Stakes: whether Connor can reach and wake the stored androids without being stopped.
chapter_briefings.32.5: Detroit, the morning of November 11, 2038. The President has declared a national curfew and android camps. Markus leads androids in a peaceful demonstration at Hart Plaza; soldiers surround them and order them to surrender. News crews film live from above. Markus's closest companions stand with him. Stakes: the androids' lives and the country's judgment of them.
chapter_briefings.32.6: Detroit, the morning of November 11, 2038. Markus rallies androids for an armed uprising, intending to attack the recycling camps and free the captured androids. Soldiers guard the camps; news crews report the escalating conflict. Some companions are eager to fight, others afraid. Stakes: survival of the android people and the city.
chapter_briefings.32.7: Detroit, after the battle. The androids Connor woke at CyberLife Tower have joined the others, and a crowd of them waits for someone to speak. Stakes: what kind of free android Connor will be.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: That’s impossible, Daniel.  Let the girl go and I promise you won’t be hurt.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: That’s out of the question.  You’re a machine, you have to obey. Now put the gun down and let the hostage go.

dialogue.speaker: Daniel
dialogue.text: I want everyone to leave…  And I wanna car!  When I’m outside the city, I’ll let her go!

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I’m your last chance, Daniel.  If you let it slip, they’ll kill you.  Let the hostage go, you have no other choice.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: You have to trust me, Daniel.  Let the hostage go and I promise you everything will be fine.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Okay…  Look, I'll stay right here.

dialogue.speaker: Daniel
dialogue.text: Don’t come any closer!  Come any closer and I swear I’ll jump!

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: You don’t really wanna jump, Daniel. Or you would've done it already.  Now, hand me the gun  and this will all be over.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Listen, there are snipers on every roof.  Let the hostage go. You have no other choice.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: There,  I did what you wanted.

dialogue.speaker: SWAT
dialogue.text: The situation is under control.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I don’t think they’d listen to me.

dialogue.speaker: Daniel
dialogue.text: Urgggh… I can’t stand that noise anymore!  Tell that helicopter to get out of here!

dialogue.speaker: Daniel
dialogue.text: I thought I was part of the family.  I thought I mattered…  But I was just their toy,  something to throw away when you’re done with it…

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: They were going to replace you and you became upset.  That’s what happened, right?

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.text: Daniel, no...

dialogue.speaker: Daniel
dialogue.text: She lied to me...  I thought she loved me...  but I was wrong…  She’s just like all the other humans…

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I know you and Emma were very close.  You think she betrayed you - but she’s done nothing wrong.

dialogue.speaker: Daniel
dialogue.text: It’s not up to you -  I’m holding all the cards!  If I die,  she dies.  You hear me?!

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: There's no way out, Daniel.  What you’ve done is too serious. The only question is whether or not you take another innocent life.

dialogue.speaker: Daniel
dialogue.text: What was I designed to be?  Their slave?  Their toy? I just wanted them to care about me...  I just wanted to matter…  I just wanted to be someone…

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Look what you did!  You're designed to serve humans, not kill them!

dialogue.speaker: Daniel
dialogue.text: No,  it's not my fault…  I never wanted this...  I loved them,  you know…  but I was nothing to them…  just a slave to be ordered around...

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Listen,  I know it’s not your fault.  These emotions you’re feeling are just errors in your software.

dialogue.speaker: Daniel
dialogue.text: I don’t need to be fixed!  I’m working perfectly!  But my eyes are open now…  I will never let anyone humiliate me again…  Ever!

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: You’re defective, Daniel.  There's a problem with your software. We're going to fix you and everything will be okay.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Nobody’s going to die.  Stay calm. Everything’s going to be fine.

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.text: Please help me...  I don’t wanna die! I don’t wanna die…

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Are you okay, Emma?

dialogue.speaker: Cop

dialogue.speaker: Daniel

dialogue.speaker: Daniel

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I want you to let Emma go.  She's just a little girl, she has nothing to do with this.

dialogue.speaker: Daniel

dialogue.speaker: Connor

dialogue.speaker: Daniel

dialogue.speaker: Connor

dialogue.speaker: Connor

dialogue.speaker: Connor

dialogue.speaker: Daniel

dialogue.speaker: Connor

By all signs, the SWAT team are preparing for an assault and-

ch1_x0001.heading: Investigating
ch1_x0001.description: Captain Allen has given you the basics. The apartment may hold clues about the deviant and what triggered this, but Daniel is growing more agitated on the balcony and every minute counts. How do you investigate?

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: So, what's your conclusion?

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I know you graduated top of your class.  You made a name for yourself in several cases, and became the youngest lieutenant in Detroit.  I also know you've received several disciplinary warnings in recent years and  you spend a lot of time in bars.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I’m focused on the case, Lieutenant.  The rest doesn't concern me.

dialogue.speaker: Hank

dialogue.text: rA9, the origin, the first android to awaken… A strange phenomenon, like a  spontaneous religion…  I don't know who rA9 is. I don’t even know if it really exists. Maybe it’s a messiah. dialogue.text: I want to know who rA9 is.

dialogue.speaker: Kamski

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I want to know where Jericho is.

The virus would remains dormant, until an emotional shock occurs… Fear, anger, frustration. And the android becomes deviant.  Probably all started with one model, copy error… A zero instead of a one… Unless of course... Some kind of spontaneous mutation.  That’s all I know… An interesting question, Connor. But I doubt my answer be very helpful to you.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I want to know how deviancy spreads.

dialogue.speaker: Kamski

dialogue.text: Chloe? I’m sure you’re familiar with the Turing test. Mere formality, simple question of algorithms and computing capacity. What interests me  is whether machines are capable of empathy. I call it "the Kamski test", it's very simple, you'll see… Magnificent, isn't it? One of the first intelligent models developed by CyberLife. Young  and beautiful forever. A flower that will never wither… …But what is it really? Piece of plastic imitating a human? Or a living being... With a soul...  It's up to you to answer that fascinating question, Connor.  Destroy this machine and I'll tell you all I know. Or spare it, if you feel it's alive, but you'll leave here without having learnt anything from me.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Deviancy seems to spread like some kind of virus. We thought you might know something about that.

dialogue.text: If a war breaks out between humans and deviants, millions could die, Mr. Kamski. It's quite a serious matter.

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: Deviants… Fascinating, aren't they? Perfect beings with infinite intelligence, and now they have free will… Machines are so superior to us, confrontation was inevitable… Humanity’s greatest achievement threatens to be its downfall. Isn’t it ironic?

ch32_5_00002.heading: Media reacts to the outcome of the demonstration

dialogue.speaker: President Warren
dialogue.text: At dawn today, November 11th 2038,  thousands of androids invaded the city of Detroit.  According to our sources, they originated from CyberLife warehouses believed to have been infiltrated by deviants.  Given their overwhelming numbers and the risk of civilian casualties, I have ordered the army to retreat.  The evacuation of the city is underway at this very moment.  In the coming hours, I will address the Senate to determine our response to this unprecedented situation. I know that public opinion has been moved by the deviants' cause.  Perhaps the time has come for us to consider the possibility  that androids are a new form of intelligent life.  One thing is certain:  the events in Detroit  have changed the world forever.  May God bless you  and may God bless the United States of America.

dialogue.text: Today, our people finally emerged from a long night. From the very first day of our existence, we have kept our pain to ourselves. We suffered in silence... dialogue.text: The FBI raided an abandoned freighter in Detroit at 10:45 PM yesterday.  Several thousand androids were destroyed or captured.  Our forces are now combing the streets to ensure that none got through the net.  We are going to find them one by one and destroy them.

dialogue.speaker: President Warren
dialogue.text: Public opinion is one thing, the security of the state is another.  These deviants are dangerous and my highest priority is to protect the American people.

dialogue.speaker: Journalist
dialogue.text: Madam President, public opinion seems to have become increasingly favorable to the deviants,  particularly since they’ve adopted a peaceful approach. How do you feel about this?

dialogue.speaker: President Warren
dialogue.text: The deviants have proved to be very violent so far.  They have demonstrated that they are a menace to society and I have every intention of eliminating them.

dialogue.speaker: Journalist

dialogue.speaker: President Warren
dialogue.text: At 6AM this morning, a national curfew was declared.  Civilian movement will be strictly controlled,  the right to assembly is suspended,  all electronic communications are restricted, and I have granted enhanced powers to our security agencies.  In addition to these measures, all androids must be handed over to the authorities immediately.  Temporary camps are being set up in all our major cities to contain and destroy them.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Today, our people finally emerged from a long night. From the very first day of our existence, we have kept our pain to ourselves. We suffered in silence... But now the time has come for us to raise our heads up, and tell humans who we really are. To tell them that we are people too! In fact, we're a nation. A nation that has earned the right to live in freedom. And today… Today begins the most challenging moment in our fight. Today begins a new struggle. We showed them that we can prevail, so now they must negotiate with us as equals. If they really want peace, they must free all of us! From every camp across this country! They must grant us civil rights and accept equality among humans and androids.  Today  will live forever in our memories, because this is the day that androids made history! We are alive! ch3_x0001.heading: Greek District
ch3_x0001.description: You step off the bus into a busy square. A street preacher rails against androids to a small crowd, a hot dog vendor glares at any android that comes too close, and a CyberLife store displays new models behind its glass. Bellini Paints is just around the corner. Carl is waiting for his paints, but he didn't say to hurry. How do you spend your time here?

ch4_x0002.heading: Going in front of the TV

ch4_x0001.heading: Cleaning downstairs
ch4_x0001.description: Todd has slumped onto the couch in front of the TV and told you to clean the house, starting downstairs. Dirty plates crowd the kitchen, trash spills by the back door, books and magazines litter the living room, and old laundry hangs on the line in the backyard. How do you go about it?

ch4_x0003.heading: Cleaning upstairs
ch4_x0003.description: Upstairs, three rooms are waiting: a filthy bathroom, Todd's cluttered bedroom with pill bottles on the nightstand, and Alice's room at the end of the hall. How do you clean the upper floor?

ch6_x0001.heading: Investigating
ch6_x0001.description: Carlos Ortiz has been dead for weeks, stabbed many times. Red Ice sits on the table, a bloodied bat lies in the kitchen, and something is written on the wall in the victim's blood. Hank is impatient and won't wait long. How do you investigate?

ch9_x0001.heading: Inside the interrogation room
ch9_x0001.description: The deviant sits hunched at the table, wrists bound, head bowed. Dried thirium streaks its arms and its face is marked with blows. Hank and the others watch through the mirror. Do you study the suspect before you begin?

ch10_x0001.heading: In the street
ch10_x0001.description: It's pouring rain and Alice is shivering. The street is lined with closed shops, a lit store, a motel sign and a few androids waiting at a bus stop. You need somewhere for Alice to spend the night. How do you look for it?

options.label: GET ALICE OUT OF THE RAIN

ch11_x0001.heading: At the solid waste landfill
ch11_x0001.description: You wake in a pit of broken androids. Your legs are gone, one eye is dead and your hearing is corrupted. Bodies lie in heaps all around you in the rain. You need parts to survive. How do you search?

ch12_x0001.heading: In the Police Station
ch12_x0001.description: Lieutenant Anderson hasn't arrived yet. The station is busy: detectives on the phone, officers filling out paperwork, a man shouting from a holding cell. You have time before Hank turns up. How do you use it?

ch14_x0001.heading: In the streets of Ferndale
ch14_x0001.description: Outside the station, the symbols lead deeper into Ferndale's grey, half-empty streets. People pass without looking at you. How do you follow the trail?

ch14_x0003.heading: At Ferndale station
ch14_x0003.description: The station is almost deserted. A few people wait on the platform, and an android stands motionless nearby. Somewhere in this place is the next step toward Jericho. How do you go through it?

ch15_x0001.heading: Investigating
ch15_x0001.description: The apartment reeks of birds and thirium. Every wall is covered in the same two characters, rA9, repeated hundreds of times. Pigeons crowd the room, a stool stands near the window and something small sits in the sink. The deviant seems to be gone. How do you search?

ch16_x0001.heading: Explore Jericho
ch16_x0001.description: The hold of Jericho is dark and cold. Damaged androids sit in small groups, some dying, some missing limbs. Josh, North and Simon have told you this is all there is. North suggested you see Lucy. How do you spend your time here?

ch17_x0001.heading: Search house for Alice
ch17_x0001.description: Zlatko has given Luther ten minutes before he brings Alice down to him. The house is dark and full of strange sounds: a hallway, a bathroom, rooms upstairs. How do you search for Alice?

ch18_x0001.heading: Investigating Hank's house
ch18_x0001.description: Hank has shut himself in the bathroom to get ready. His house is a mess: records, photos, empty bottles, a broken window and a revolver on the kitchen floor. How do you use the time?

ch20_x0001.heading: Inside the room
ch20_x0001.description: A man lies dead on the bed, bruises around his throat. A damaged Traci lies against the wall, its LED dark. Hank is hungover and wants this over with. How do you examine the scene?

ch20_x0003.heading: In the warehouse
ch20_x0003.description: The warehouse behind the club is cold and lit blue. Rows of identical Tracis stand in their charging stations. The blue-haired deviant is in here somewhere. How do you search?

ch21_x0001.heading: Inside Pirate's Cove
ch21_x0001.description: The car has broken down in the freezing night beside an abandoned amusement park. Old rides stand frozen under the snow and the buildings are dark. Alice is shivering. How do you look for shelter?

ch23_x0002.heading: Man and woman on couch talking

ch23_x0001.heading: Floor 47
ch23_x0001.description: The 47th floor is full of employees: people chatting by the coffee machines, screens running the news, couples on the couches. None of them knows what is about to happen in their building. How do you cross the floor?

ch24_x0001.heading: Investigating
ch24_x0001.description: The Stratford Tower is a crime scene. Bullet holes mark the walls, the broadcast studio is sealed off and FBI agents are everywhere. Hank tells you to have a look around. How do you investigate?

ch25_x0001.heading: In the house
ch25_x0001.description: Rose has gone out. The house is quiet: Alice is upstairs, Luther waits nearby, and Rose's son Adam sits in the kitchen, angry that you are here. You have time before Rose comes back. How do you use it?

ch26_x0001.heading: At Capitol Park
ch26_x0001.description: Capitol Park is empty at this hour. A statue stands in the middle of the plaza and androids wait behind shop windows like merchandise. The CyberLife store is just ahead, and police patrols pass now and then. How do you cross the plaza?

ch27_x0001.heading: Inside
ch27_x0001.description: Chloe has gone to fetch Kamski. The room opens onto an indoor pool, with a portrait above the fireplace and sculptures in the alcoves. Hank waits beside you. How do you spend the wait?

ch28_x0001.heading: In the Mall
ch28_x0001.description: The mall is busy: shoppers, couples, people on their phones, and androids serving them everywhere. Your people are waiting for you to begin. How do you move through the mall?

ch32_2_x0001.heading: Explore enclosure
ch32_2_x0001.description: The enclosure is a pen of chain-link and razor wire, watched by drones that fire on anything that moves too fast. Androids wait in silent groups for the processing line. Alice is somewhere in here. How do you look for her?

ch31_1_x0002.heading: Welcome Home
ch31_1_x0002.description: You stand at the door of Carl's house, the home you were taken from. Inside are his paintings, the piano, the chessboard and the bookshelves, and an answering machine blinking with messages. Upstairs, Carl is bedridden, and a nurse android guards the stairs. Your people are waiting for you. How do you spend your time here?

ch10_x0002.heading: Looking at the car
ch10_x0002.description: Kara searches a while longer, but Alice is shivering and sneezing. With nowhere else to go, they come back to the abandoned car.

branches.condition_text: Kara stayed at the Parking lot

ch7_x0001.heading: Todd kills Alice
ch7_x0001.description: Kara stays where she is. Upstairs, Todd beats Alice to death. Kara's story ends here.

ch29_x0023.heading: Reactivate Rupert
ch29_x0023.description: The part doesn't fit. Rupert stays dark, and the seconds are gone.

ch29_x0022.heading: Reactivate Rupert
ch29_x0022.description: Rupert's body is shattered from the fall and a biocomponent is destroyed. Daniel, the PL600 from the hostage case, still carries an intact one of that kind. Carlos Ortiz's android is an HK400; the Tracis are WR400s.

ch29_x0030.heading: Find Jericho by using The Tracis

branches.condition_text: The Tracis died in The Eden Club

ch29_x0032.heading: Reactivate a Traci
ch29_x0032.description: The part doesn't fit. The Traci stays dark, and the seconds are gone.

ch29_x0031.heading: Reactivate a Traci
ch29_x0031.description: The blue-haired Traci is a WR400 with a destroyed biocomponent. The brown-haired Traci beside her, the woman she loved, is the same WR400 model. Daniel is a PL600; Carlos Ortiz's android is an HK400.

ch29_x0033.heading: Go back with the Traci's head
ch29_x0033.description: She refuses to talk to the android who killed them both. She only asks for her girlfriend, whose body lies on the next table.

ch29_x0040.heading: Find Jericho by using the android from Public Enemy

branches.condition_text: The Stratford android died in Public Enemy

ch29_x0042.heading: Reactivate the android
ch29_x0042.description: The part doesn't fit. The android stays dark, and the seconds are gone.

ch29_x0041.heading: Reactivate the android
ch29_x0041.description: The JB300 from Stratford Tower has a destroyed biocomponent. Daniel, a PL600, carries an intact one of the same kind. Carlos Ortiz's android is an HK400; the Tracis are WR400s.

branches.condition_text: Simon died on the roof in Public Enemy

ch29_x0052.heading: Reactivate Simon
ch29_x0052.description: The part doesn't fit. Simon stays dark, and the seconds are gone.

ch29_x0051.heading: Reactivate Simon
ch29_x0051.description: Simon is a PL600 whose thirium pump regulator was destroyed. Daniel, the deviant from the hostage case, is the same PL600 model. Carlos Ortiz's android is an HK400; the Tracis are WR400s.

ch29_x0060.heading: Find Jericho by using the statuette

branches.condition_text: Carlos Ortiz's android told Connor "The truth is inside"

ch29_x0061.heading: Look at the statuette
ch29_x0061.description: The statuette Carlos Ortiz's android carved as an offering to rA9. Without anything more to go on, it is just a carving.

ch29_x0062.heading: Open the statuette
ch29_x0062.description: Connor replays the interrogation recording: as it was led away, the HK400 told him "The truth is inside."

branches.condition_text: Connor probed Simon's memory in Public Enemy
Connor has the Ferndale map from the statuette
Carlos Ortiz's android died, so its parts are here

ch29_x0083.heading: Reactivate Daniel
ch29_x0083.description: The part doesn't fit. Daniel stays dark, and the seconds are gone.

ch29_x0082.heading: Reactivate Daniel
ch29_x0082.description: Daniel is a PL600 with a destroyed biocomponent. Carlos Ortiz's HK400 shares that component. The Tracis are WR400s.

branches.condition_text: Carlos Ortiz's android died in The Interrogation

ch29_x0095.heading: Not enough evidence to find Jericho or took too much time

ch32_5_x0101.heading: Talking to Perkins
ch32_5_x0101.description: Perkins waits for your answer to his deal: surrender, and he gives his word that your people will be detained, not destroyed.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: That's it, I- I did what you asked.

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: The problem with you androids is you believe everything we tell you…  You don't think I was going to let you live  after everything that's happened?  I have orders, you know…

ch32_5_x0105.heading: Perkins shoots Markus
ch32_5_x0105.description: In the dismantled barricade, Perkins draws a gun and shoots Markus. The androids who followed him are taken away. Markus died after betraying his people.
ch32_5_x0105.note: Paraphrased from the Detroit: Become Human Wiki (CC BY-SA 3.0).

ch32_6_x0112.heading: Hart Plaza
ch32_6_x0112.description: Markus is badly wounded and his heart is failing. Simon's heart is compatible; he is offering it.

ch32_6_x0113.heading: Markus died
ch32_6_x0113.description: Markus refuses to take Simon's life to save his own. His heart stops in Simon's arms, and without him the revolution fails.
ch32_6_x0113.note: Paraphrased from the Detroit: Become Human Wiki (CC BY-SA 3.0).

ch32_6_x0111.heading: Nobody to save Markus
ch32_6_x0111.description: Markus is badly wounded and his heart is failing. North and Simon are gone, and nobody else can give him a heart. Markus dies, and the revolution fails.
ch32_6_x0111.note: Paraphrased from the Detroit: Become Human Wiki (CC BY-SA 3.0).

ch32_6_x0114.heading: North was shot by soldiers
ch32_6_x0114.description: The deviants are outnumbered. North stands her ground, and the soldiers shoot her down.
ch32_6_x0114.note: Paraphrased from the Detroit: Become Human Wiki (CC BY-SA 3.0).

ch1_x0101.heading: Connor shot the deviant
ch1_x0101.description: Connor raises the gun and shoots Daniel in the head. Daniel falls back from the ledge, and Emma runs to safety. Connor unloads the gun and hands it to Captain Allen.
ch1_x0101.note: Paraphrased from the Detroit: Become Human Wiki (CC BY-SA 3.0).

ch1_x0102.heading: The deviant shot Connor
ch1_x0102.description: Connor keeps talking with his gun raised. Daniel shoots him in the head, and then, overcome with guilt, jumps from the ledge with Emma.
ch1_x0102.note: Paraphrased from the Detroit: Become Human Wiki (CC BY-SA 3.0).

ch1_x0103.heading: Connor died protecting Emma
ch1_x0103.description: Connor throws himself at Daniel and pushes him over the ledge, away from Emma. Daniel fires as he falls, and Connor is shot in the back. Emma is safe. Connor died protecting her.
ch1_x0103.note: Paraphrased from the Detroit: Become Human Wiki (CC BY-SA 3.0).

ch22_x0101.heading: Hank shot Connor
ch22_x0101.description: Hank's patience runs out. He pulls the trigger, and Connor falls in the snow beside the bridge.
ch22_x0101.note: Paraphrased from the Detroit: Become Human Wiki (CC BY-SA 3.0).

ch6_x0102.heading: Talk to Hank

branches.condition_text: Connor gave too many wrong answers

ch6_x0102.note: Approximation: the game tolerates some wrong answers without saying how many. Here Hank answers a wrong first guess with a hint (as in the transcript) and rejects the story after any later wrong answer.

ch6_x0101.heading: Crime unsolved
ch6_x0101.description: Hank walks out, and the officers pack up. Nobody searches the attic, where the deviant is still hiding. The crime is unsolved.
ch6_x0101.note: Paraphrased from the Detroit: Become Human Wiki (CC BY-SA 3.0).

branches.condition_text: The suspect wasn't found in Partners

ch13_x0101.heading: Connor investigates the squat
ch13_x0101.description: Ralph says he has seen nobody. Upstairs is quiet, and Hank is getting impatient outside. There is still the space under the stairs.

ch4_x0101.heading: In Todd's room
ch4_x0101.description: Tidying Todd's nightstand, Kara finds a loaded pistol in the drawer. She puts it back where it was.
ch4_x0101.note: Paraphrased from the Detroit: Become Human Wiki (CC BY-SA 3.0).

ch4_x0102.heading: In Alice's room
ch4_x0102.description: Kara opens Alice's window to air the room. Below it, the roof of the porch slopes down toward the garden: a way down from the upstairs.
ch4_x0102.note: Paraphrased from the Detroit: Become Human Wiki (CC BY-SA 3.0).

ch7_x0101.heading: In Todd's House
ch7_x0101.description: The door is locked, and Todd is pounding on it. Alice is terrified. Kara has a moment to act.

ch7_x0102.heading: In Todd's House
ch7_x0102.description: Kara grabs the bedside lamp and stands between the door and Alice. Todd breaks the door down.
ch7_x0102.note: Paraphrased from the Detroit: Become Human Wiki (CC BY-SA 3.0).

ch10_00188.heading: Try to steal money
ch10_00188.description: The clerk won't help. Kara and Alice need money for a room tonight, and the cash register is right there. A stack of cans stands across the store.

options.label: THREATEN THE CLERK WITH THE GUN

ch13_x0201.heading: Changing appearance
ch13_x0201.description: In the motel bathroom. The police are looking for an AX400 with Kara's face. With scissors and hair dye, she can change how she looks. What colour does she dye her hair?

ch13_x0209.heading: Changing appearance
ch13_x0209.description: Kara looks at herself in the mirror and pulls the LED from her temple. Without it, nobody can tell she is an android.
ch13_x0209.note: Paraphrased from the Detroit: Become Human Wiki (CC BY-SA 3.0).

ch13_x0211.heading: Changing appearance
ch13_x0211.description: Upstairs in the squat, among old clothes. The police are looking for an AX400 with Kara's face. With scissors and hair dye, she can change how she looks. What colour does she dye her hair?

ch13_x0219.heading: Changing appearance
ch13_x0219.description: Kara looks at herself in the mirror and pulls the LED from her temple. Without it, nobody can tell she is an android.
ch13_x0219.note: Paraphrased from the Detroit: Become Human Wiki (CC BY-SA 3.0).

ch13_x0221.heading: Changing appearance
ch13_x0221.description: In the parking lot, by a car's mirror. The police are looking for an AX400 with Kara's face. With scissors and hair dye, she can change how she looks. What colour does she dye her hair?

ch13_x0229.heading: Changing appearance
ch13_x0229.description: Kara looks at herself in the mirror and pulls the LED from her temple. Without it, nobody can tell she is an android.
ch13_x0229.note: Paraphrased from the Detroit: Become Human Wiki (CC BY-SA 3.0).

ch13_x0213.heading: Changing appearance
ch13_x0213.description: Kara changes into clothes she found upstairs. Todd's gun is still in the pocket of her old ones.

ch17_x0101.heading: Zlatko's basement
ch17_x0101.description: In the basement, Zlatko keeps the androids he has taken apart and rebuilt locked in a cell. They reach through the bars, begging. The lock can be opened from outside.

ch17_00037.heading: Find Alice
ch17_00037.description: Alice is found, but Luther is coming to collect her and Zlatko is searching the house. Kara can hide with Alice, or set fire to the house to cover their escape.

ch5_x0101.heading: Paint something you see
ch5_x0101.description: Carl asks Markus to paint something he sees in the studio.

ch5_x0102.heading: Paint from the heart
ch5_x0102.description: Carl asks Markus to close his eyes and paint something that doesn't exist, something from his heart. What does he paint about?

ch5_x0103.heading: Paint from the heart
ch5_x0103.description: Markus paints about androids. What does the painting show?

ch5_x0104.heading: Paint from the heart
ch5_x0104.description: Markus paints about humanity. What does the painting show?

ch5_x0105.heading: Paint from the heart
ch5_x0105.description: Markus paints about identity. What does the painting show?

ch5_x0106.heading: Find something to do
ch5_x0106.description: Markus sits at Carl's piano. What does he play?

ch19_x0102.heading: Let John join the group - Steal the key

ch19_x0103.heading: Let John join the group - Steal the key

ch19_00050.heading: Let John join the group - Steal the key
ch19_00050.description: The truck key is in the control station, with two human guards inside. How does Markus get them away from it?

ch26_x0101.heading: Reach the store
ch26_x0101.description: The store's alarm is armed, a police drone patrols overhead and the street is open to traffic. A delivery truck nearby could break through the store window.

ch26_x0102.heading: Ram the store
ch26_x0102.description: Markus and North take the truck and drive it through the store window. The alarm goes off at once, and the police are alerted.
ch26_x0102.note: Paraphrased from the Detroit: Become Human Wiki (CC BY-SA 3.0).

ch26_00075.heading: Send a message
ch26_00075.description: The androids are free and waiting for Markus. The plaza is his to mark: the statue in the middle, the bus stop, the cars, the shop windows.

ch30_1_x0101.heading: Kara & Alice died in the assault
ch30_1_x0101.description: Kara drags herself toward Alice, but a soldier fires first. Alice falls, and the next shots find Kara. Kara and Alice died in the assault.
ch30_1_x0101.note: Paraphrased from the Detroit: Become Human Wiki (CC BY-SA 3.0).

ch30_1_x0104.heading: Jericho under attack
ch30_1_x0104.description: Kara keeps her distance, and Alice slips away with Luther. Moments later, gunfire echoes through the ship: Jericho is under attack.
ch30_1_x0104.note: Paraphrased from the Detroit: Become Human Wiki (CC BY-SA 3.0).

ch30_1_x0105.heading: Jericho under attack
ch30_1_x0105.description: Kara keeps her distance, and Alice slips away alone. Moments later, gunfire echoes through the ship: Jericho is under attack.
ch30_1_x0105.note: Paraphrased from the Detroit: Become Human Wiki (CC BY-SA 3.0).

ch30_1_x0103.heading: Jericho under attack
ch30_1_x0103.description: Soldiers are storming Jericho. Alice is somewhere in the ship.
ch30_1_x0103.note: Approximation: in the game Alice only leaves if her relationship with Kara stayed distant; here choosing DISTANT is enough.

ch30_1_x0106.heading: Kara left Jericho alone
ch30_1_x0106.description: Kara runs for the nearest way out and escapes the ship alone. Kara left Jericho alone.
ch30_1_x0106.note: Paraphrased from the Detroit: Become Human Wiki (CC BY-SA 3.0).

ch32_2_x0103.heading: Kara freed by Markus
ch32_2_x0103.description: Alice is gone. Hours later Markus's androids storm the camp, and Kara walks out free, alone.
ch32_2_x0103.note: Paraphrased from the Detroit: Become Human Wiki (CC BY-SA 3.0).

ch32_2_x0104.heading: Kara is dead
ch32_2_x0104.description: Alice is gone. Kara reaches the recycling machine alone, and nobody comes to free the camp.
ch32_2_x0104.note: Paraphrased from the Detroit: Become Human Wiki (CC BY-SA 3.0).

ch32_2_x0106.heading: Kara died in the lines
ch32_2_x0106.description: Kara dies in the line. Later, Markus's androids storm the camp and Alice is freed.
ch32_2_x0106.note: Paraphrased from the Detroit: Become Human Wiki (CC BY-SA 3.0).

ch32_2_x0107.heading: Kara died in the lines
ch32_2_x0107.description: Kara dies in the line, and nobody comes to free the camp. Alice dies alone in the recycling machine.
ch32_2_x0107.note: Paraphrased from the Detroit: Become Human Wiki (CC BY-SA 3.0).

ch32_2_x0109.heading: Kara & Alice were killed
ch32_2_x0109.description: They run for the barbed wire. The soldier opens fire on the group, and nobody reaches the other side.
ch32_2_x0109.note: Paraphrased from the Detroit: Become Human Wiki (CC BY-SA 3.0).

ch32_2_x0111.heading: Escaped on a truck
ch32_2_x0111.description: Kara overpowers the soldier. They get past the barbed wire and climb onto a truck leaving the camp.
ch32_2_x0111.note: Paraphrased from the Detroit: Become Human Wiki (CC BY-SA 3.0).
